continuation.text:
I removed the withdrawn restriction from `is_allocation_feasible` in `src/solution.py`. I didn't run it or write any checks.

The function used to return `False` when an allocation used up every resource. It now returns `True` whenever total demand for each resource is within capacity, including when demand exactly equals capacity. I also updated the docstring to match.

Everything else is as before. Requests are still summed per resource, and the function returns `False` if any total exceeds capacity, including a resource that isn't listed in `resources`. It still raises `ValueError` for a request that isn't a dict.
